extracted.name: Singapore Sling Cocktail
extracted.description: This Singapore sling recipe with grenadine and pineapple juice is a potent version of the classic gin-based cocktail created at the Raffles Hotel.
instruction_lines: Fill a Collins glass with 1 cup ice and place in the freezer.

Combine pineapple juice, gin, cherry-flavored brandy, lime juice, grenadine, triple sec, and Bénédictine in a cocktail shaker. Add 1 cup ice, cover, and shake until chilled. Strain into the prepared Collins glass.
Garnish with pineapple slice and cherry.
